measures:
HOW THE GATE MEASURES — build to these definitions exactly

  Game = new_app_state(seed=42); tabs are shown by setting view.tab (and the
  gate also tries active_tab/current_tab); a draw is view.regions cleared +
  view.draw(screen); a press is view.handle_click(region.rect.center) then
  gilded.ui.app._apply_action(state, action).

  C8.1 ZOOM TIERS. On the Atlas tab the draw registers three Regions with
  group="atlas_zoom" and action={"zoom": "continent"} / {"zoom": "region"} /
  {"zoom": "parish"}. Pressing one sets view.atlas_tier to that string and
  the next draw paints THAT tier. Measured: the content band
  Rect(0,160,W,H-200) must differ between every pair of tiers on >= 5% of
  its pixels (per-channel diff > 24). The legend must render (through
  pygame.font.Font.render, so real text) tier words: at Parish the legend
  rows include the words "city", "regiment" and "strike"; at Continent the
  word "capital". This is the map law's tiered world: Continent = houses
  and their capitals (fills + capital glyph, no province labels); Region =
  today's map (endowments, rails, fronts, labels); Parish = the province
  level — cities sized by population, regiments where armies stand, strike
  marks where labour is out, plus rails and fronts. Selection, province
  labels and every existing Atlas test keep working at the Region tier,
  which stays the default so C1..C7 are unchanged.

  C8.2 PORTRAITS. On the House tab at t0 the draw registers >= 6 Regions
  with group="portrait" and action={"portrait": <character id>}, each rect
  >= 48x48 px, and inside each rect a real portrait image is blitted (scaled
  to fit, engraving intact). Measured: the crop of any two portrait rects
  differs on >= 10% of pixels; a second draw reproduces each crop EXACTLY
  (identical-on-redraw). gilded/assets/portraits/ holds >= 24 image files
  plus LICENSES.md. Provide gilded/ui/portraits.py with
  portrait_for(character) -> absolute path, deterministic from the
  character's stable id/name (never game.rng), choosing man_* / woman_*
  by the character's sex when the model has one; cache loaded Surfaces.
  Put the portrait ON the existing court cards (house_tab.py court seats /
  court_cards) — no new panel, no overlap (test_no_text_overlap and
  test_turn40_house_tab_zero_overlaps stand).

  C8.3 TRANSITIONS. New module gilded/ui/transitions.py with
  frames(src: pygame.Surface, dst: pygame.Surface, steps: int) ->
  list[pygame.Surface]: exactly `steps` frames, deterministic; frames[0]
  within 5% of src, frames[-1] within 5% of dst, the middle frame differs
  from BOTH ends on >= 5% of pixels (a cross-fade via per-frame alpha does
  this; a wipe also works). Wiring: when a tab Region (group="tabs") is
  pressed the view sets view.last_transition = {"kind": "tab", "steps": N}
  with N >= 4, and when the End Turn Region (action {"end_turn": True}) is
  pressed it sets {"kind": "end_turn", "steps": N}. The app loop
  (gilded/ui/app.py) must actually PLAY those frames between the old and
  new page at the frame clock (a test with a fake clock proves the frames
  are drawn in order); headless tests need no timing.

  C8.4 AMBIENT BED PER ACT. gilded/audio.py: SOUND_EVENTS gains
  "ambient_act1" -> "act1_calm.flac", "ambient_act2" -> "act2_tense.flac",
  "ambient_act3" -> "act3_grand.flac" (files copied into
  gilded/assets/audio/); audio.resolve(event) returns their paths; each
  loads in pygame.mixer.Sound with get_length() >= 60 s and the three
  sha256 differ. New audio.ambient_event_for(game) -> str returns
  "ambient_act1" for turns 0–25, "ambient_act2" for 26–50, "ambient_act3"
  for 51+ (the act bands C7 fixed). The running game switches the bed when
  the act changes (hook on end_turn), keeps looping it, and play() still
  returns False under Settings(mute=True). gilded/assets/audio/LICENSES.md
  names all three files with their Musopen/Commons sources.

  C8.5 THE ART PASS. At t40 on seed 42, the fraction of screen pixels
  within 24/channel of one of the 13 pinned inks in gilded/ui/palette.py
  must be >= 0.95 on House, >= 0.95 on Powers, >= 0.90 on Atlas (today
  0.919 / 0.933 / 0.640). The Atlas is the work: OCEAN_COLOR, BORDER_COLOR,
  NAME_COLOR, GLYPH_COLOR, FRONT_COLOR, MINOR_COLOR, the owner fills and
  the neutral rail slate in gilded/ui/widgets.py / atlas_view.py must
  become pinned inks (ocean = SLATE or FIELD, fills from SAGE / WHEAT /
  CARD / FIELD / PAPER, borders INK / INK2 / DIM, labels INK on a CARD
  plate, glyphs INK). Houses are told apart by hatching / border weight /
  the capital glyph, not by new hues — Banknote is an engraving, not a
  paint box. RIVER stays reserved (zero exact-RIVER pixels anywhere on the
  Atlas). Portraits are exempt from nothing: their pixels count, so plate
  them on CARD and keep them <= the size the card allows. Do NOT add a hex
  to palette.py; the 13 inks are the palette.

rules: Deterministic per seed; no game.rng on any presentation path.

Do not weaken, skip or mark any committed test, census number, floor, or
  the type scale. Accent law stands: VERMILLION marks consequence only
  (<= 5 per screen), GOLD marks the player only.

Use the CodeIndex tool FIRST for every symbol lookup before any Grep/Read
  crawl.
